fields.summary_ko.0: Eli Lilly (LLY) stock appreciated +31.9% YTD (vs. sector average +26.2%), beating consensus on both Q3 results and revenue.
fields.summary_ko.1: Mounjaro and Zepbound GLP-1 drugs show strength, with new drugs Kisunla, Omvoh, and Jaypirca contributing, while oral obesity treatment Mounjaro is expected to be a game-changer.
